clue.text: Reckless attitude made Alice very mad

indicators.note: made in the sense of fashioned or put together, so the following words are built into a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A girl's carefree approach drove her into a fury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' is the anagram signal; ALICE VERY MAD (twelve letters) rearranges into the answer. 'mad' looks like the end of the sentence but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A happy-go-lucky, couldn't-care-less outlook is the classic sense of this hyphenated phrase used as a noun.

clue.text: Interior design with little doubt requires propriety

parts.note: decor is the furnishing and decoration of a room
um is a small hesitant sound expressing doubt

explanation.surface: A decorator's hesitant manner calls for good behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean correct, seemly behaviour in polite society.

clue.text: He guarantees it's an IOU

explanation.surface: A man stands surety for a written promise to pay.
explanation.definitionFit: One who vouches for something guarantees it; a slip exchangeable for money or goods works like a written IOU.

clue.text: At length I made good — at the eleventh hour?

indicators.note: made good suggests something repaired and put back together differently, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone finally succeeded after a long time, right at the last moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made good' is the anagram signal working on AT LENGTH I. The question mark marks the definition as playful: the eleventh hour taken literally as eleven o'clock at night.
explanation.definitionFit: Eleven p.m. is literally a time very late in the evening, which the playful definition hints at.

clue.text: Arab leader, for instance, is in need of protection

indicators.note: leader means the opening letter of the word Arab

parts.note: eg is the abbreviation for exempli gratia, for example
taken as written

explanation.surface: A sheikh, say, needs to be kept safe.
explanation.definitionFit: Under someone's auspices means under their sponsorship or shelter, the sense of this word.

clue.text: Study examination question

parts.note: to con is an old verb meaning to study or learn by heart
a test is an exam

explanation.surface: A student revises for an exam question.
explanation.walkthrough: 'question' looks like a noun in an exam, but it is the verb meaning to dispute.
explanation.definitionFit: To dispute or challenge a result is to call it into doubt.

clue.text: Will find another answer

explanation.surface: Someone will work out a different solution.
explanation.definitionFit: Will as determination is firmness of purpose; to solve again, written with a hyphen, is to work out anew.

clue.text: Go ahead and proposition the lady

explanation.surface: A suitor is urged to approach a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Progressing forward is one sense; making romantic or sexual overtures to someone is the other.

clue.text: Story of bank deposit

explanation.surface: A tale about money put into a bank.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrative report of events is one sense; an arrangement holding money with a bank is the other.

clue.text: Hereditary factors are singularly evident from birth

parts.note: genes are the units of heredity
is is the singular form of the verb are

explanation.surface: Inherited traits are plain to see from the moment a baby is born.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means origin or coming into being, as in the first book of the Bible.

clue.text: Best to transfer to Islington

parts.note: to second is to transfer an employee temporarily to other work
taken as written
Islington, a district of north London, has the postcode N1, read as N ONE

explanation.surface: The best option is to move to a London borough.
explanation.walkthrough: Islington is in north London with the postcode N1; spelling the figure out gives N ONE. The first 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Unbeatable or unsurpassed, inferior to no other, is what 'best' conveys.

clue.text: Make money outlining article of pottery

indicators.note: outlining means the money word surrounds the article word

parts.note: to earn is to make money
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Turning a profit by sketching a piece of ceramics.
explanation.definitionFit: Made of baked clay describes crockery and other fired ware.

clue.text: Varnish the man will put into a bag

indicators.note: put into means the phrase for the man will goes inside the bag word

parts.note: a sac is a bag or pouch
he'll is the contraction of he will

explanation.surface: A man packs some varnish into a sack.
explanation.definitionFit: A resin from the lac insect dissolved in alcohol is used as a wood finish.

clue.text: Some crude murals made people raise objections

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Badly painted wall pictures provoked complaints.
explanation.definitionFit: To object or hesitate on grounds of principle is the verb's sense, which the clue frames as the reaction the murals caused.

clue.text: Agent makes attempt to gamble very little before noon

indicators.note: before places the tiny word ahead of the noon letter

parts.note: a go is a try or attempt
to bet is to gamble
wee is Scottish for small

explanation.surface: An agent tries a small flutter in the morning.
explanation.definitionFit: An intermediary who negotiates between parties acts as an agent.

clue.text: Where bakers may work at subsistence level

explanation.surface: Bakers working at a bare living wage.
explanation.definitionFit: A production line for loaves is the playful sense; living on the poverty threshold is the idiom.

clue.text: Tito's real potential as a philosopher

indicators.note: potential as raw possibility suggests the letters could be made into something else

parts.note: taken as written, with the S
taken as written

explanation.surface: The Yugoslav leader's true promise as a thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'potential' is the anagram signal; TITOS REAL is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek thinker, pupil of Plato and tutor of Alexander, is a famous philosopher.

clue.text: Laying it on thick one minute after zero hour

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
past means after, as in a time
zero hour written as O, the figure nought

explanation.surface: Just after midnight someone exaggerates wildly.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a clock time, one minute past zero hour, the pieces fall in order. The definition looks like flattery, but it is paint.
explanation.definitionFit: Paint applied so heavily that brush marks stand out is a technique of thick application.

clue.text: Songsters cite Tim in error

indicators.note: in error means wrongly placed, so the letters of cite Tim are rearranged

explanation.surface: Singers name a man by mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: Small birds of the tit family are songbirds.

clue.text: Take it as read that one is in a job

indicators.note: is in means the one letter sits inside the job word

parts.note: a post is a job or position
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Assume someone is employed.
explanation.definitionFit: To put forward as a premise is to assume something is true.

clue.text: Choose a chopper and mattock

parts.note: to pick is to choose
an axe is a chopping tool

explanation.surface: Selecting a cutting tool and a digging tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A mattock is a digging tool with a pointed head, much like this pointed hand tool.

clue.text: Trim Fido's fur a little bit

parts.note: to snip is to cut or trim
Fido is a stock name for a dog, a pet; the 's is is

explanation.surface: Clip the dog's coat a little.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'Trim Fido is for a little bit': the 's is is, and 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A small piece or fragment of something, especially of news or text.

clue.text: Excellent investments

explanation.surface: Great investments.
explanation.definitionFit: First-rate is an old exclamation of approval; funds used to start or run a business are the money sense.

clue.text: Fabric acquired from a mill in Enfield

indicators.note: acquired from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Cloth bought from a factory in a north London suburb.
explanation.walkthrough: Enfield is a borough on the northern edge of London.
explanation.definitionFit: Cloth woven from flax is a textile.

clue.text: Retired detectives get into trouble — in a manner of speaking

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or drawn back, so the detectives' letters are written backwards

parts.note: CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, British plain-clothes detectives

indicators.note: trouble means disturb, so the letters of into are rearranged

explanation.surface: Ex-police officers find themselves in difficulty, so to speak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' turns CID into DIC; 'trouble' rearranges INTO into TION. 'get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Enunciation, the way words are chosen and pronounced, is a style of talking.

clue.text: Business meeting makes pronouncement relinquishing rights

indicators.note: makes pronouncement says a word spoken out loud is what counts here

parts.note: cession is the formal handing over of rights or territory

explanation.surface: A board meeting announces a surrender of rights.
explanation.definitionFit: A sitting of a court, council or board for business.

clue.text: Agitated joyriders find satisfaction there

explanation.surface: Excited car thieves get their thrills from skidding.
explanation.definitionFit: Flustered and confused is the idiom; a car spinning out of control is the literal sense.

clue.text: Cease to care if dividends fall in value

explanation.surface: Stop caring if your share payouts drop.
explanation.definitionFit: Becoming bored is the idiom; a falling rate of return on money is the financial reading.
